## Symptom

`apps/api_server/src/__tests__/issue_1186_sandbox_foreground.test.ts > reliably keeps the launcher alive until down completes its acknowledged stop` times out (30s) intermittently.

## Evidence (2026-07-28 MEGA-PR run, unmodified origin/main 16d222788 and descendants)

- Fails in full-suite runs whenever the machine is under load (multiple concurrent vitest suites / npm installs): observed in 5 separate worktrees plus the baseline run on unmodified main.
- Fails even in isolation while other heavy suites run elsewhere on the machine.
- Passes in a full-suite run on a lightly loaded machine (memory worktree run: 3594/3594).

The test iterates the sandbox launcher lifecycle 20 times inside one 30s vitest timeout; under CPU contention the iterations exceed the budget. It is environment-sensitivity, not a product regression — the same SHA both passes and fails depending on load.

## Suggested fix

Either raise the per-test timeout and/or reduce iterations (e.g. 5 iterations with a per-iteration deadline), or gate the 20x reliability loop behind an env flag for CI where load is controlled.

Filed as an autonomous follow-up from the 2026-07-28 MEGA-PR run (branch mega/run-2026-07-28).
title: Flaky test: issue_1186_sandbox_foreground times out under machine load
